Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class RuleExecutor

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.RuleExecutor
public final class RuleExecutor extends Object
Executes all enabled AuditRule strategies registered in a RuleRegistry against a single Playwright Page and returns the aggregated RuleResult list.

Execution model

Rules are executed sequentially in registration order on the calling thread. Playwright Page objects are not thread-safe; parallelism across files is achieved at the file level (one thread per file, each with its own Page), not within a single page evaluation.

Fault isolation

Each rule is wrapped in a try/catch. An unhandled exception from one rule produces an RuleResult.Status.ERROR result and execution continues with the next rule. No single broken rule can abort the evaluation of a file.

Thread safety

RuleExecutor is stateless after construction. The RuleRegistry reference is read-only during execution. Multiple threads may hold their own RuleExecutor instance (sharing the same registry) and call execute(Page) concurrently without external synchronisation.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      public List<RuleResult> execute(com.microsoft.playwright.Page page)
      Executes all enabled rules in registration order against page and returns the aggregated results.

      The returned list is unmodifiable and contains exactly one RuleResult per enabled rule (PASS, FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED). Disabled rules are silently omitted.

      Parameters:
      page - fully loaded Playwright page; must not be null
      Returns:
      unmodifiable list of results in execution order; never null

    • executeSingle

      public RuleResult executeSingle(String ruleId, com.microsoft.playwright.Page page)
      Executes a single named rule against page. Useful for targeted re-runs or debugging.
      Parameters:
      ruleId - rule identifier to execute
      page - target page
      Returns:
      result of the rule execution, or a SKIPPED result if the rule is not found in the registry
